```bash
      {
        "id": "890375782",
        "parameter": "placeholder",
        "type": "outcome"
      }
    ],
    "type": "workflow_parameters"
  }'
```

`POST /workflows/{workflow_id}/start`

Initiates a flow with a trigger type of `WORKFLOW_MANUAL_START`.

You application must be authorized to use the `Manage Box Relay` application
scope within the developer console.

```json
    {
      "id": "12345678",

    "type": "flow"
  },
  "folder": {
    "id": "87654321",
    "type": "folder"
  },
  "outcomes": [
    {

      "parameter": "placeholder",
      "type": "outcome"

  ],

}
```

<h1 id="box-platform-api-zip-downloads">Zip Downloads</h1>

## Create zip download

<a id="opIdpost_zip_downloads"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/zip_downloads \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}" \
  -d '{
    "download_file_name": "January Financials",
    "items": [
      {
        "id": "12345",
        "type": "file"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /zip_downloads`

Creates a request to download multiple files and folders as a single `zip`
archive file. This API does not return the archive but instead performs all
the checks to ensure that the user has access to all the items, and then
returns a `download_url` and a `status_url` that can be used to download the
archive.

The limit for an archive is either the Account's upload limit or
10,000 files, whichever is met first

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "download_file_name": "January Financials",
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "12345",
      "type": "file"
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="create-zip-download-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[ZipDownloadRequest](#schemazipdownloadrequest)|false|none|
|» download_file_name|body|string|false|The optional name of the `zip` archive. This name will be appended by the<br>`.zip` file extension, for example `January Financials.zip`.|
|» items|body|[object]|true|A list of items to add to the `zip` archive. These can<br>be folders or files.|
|» » id|body|string|true|The identifier of the item to add to the archive. When this item is<br>a folder then this can not be the root folder with ID `0`.|
|» » type|body|string|true|The type of the item to add to the archive.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » type|file|
|» » type|folder.|

> Example responses

> 202 Response

```json
{
  "download_url": "https://dl.boxcloud.com/2.0/zip_downloads/29l00nfxDyHOt7RphI9zT_w==nDnZEDjY2S8iEWWCHEEiptFxwoWojjlibZjJ6geuE5xnXENDTPxzgbks_yY=/content",
  "expires_at": "2020-07-22T11:26:08Z",
  "name_conflicts": [
    [
      {
        "download_name": "3aa6a7.pdf",
        "id": "12345",
        "original_name": "Report.pdf",
        "type": "file"
      },
      {

        "id": "34325",
        "original_name": "Report.pdf",
        "type": "file"
      }
    ]
  ],
  "status_url": "https://api.box.com/2.0/zip_downloads/29l00nfxDyHOt7RphI9zT_w==nDnZEDjY2S8iEWWCHEEiptFxwoWojjlibZjJ6geuE5xnXENDTPxzgbks_yY=/status"
```
```json
}
```

<h3 id="create-zip-download-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|202|Accepted|If the `zip` archive is ready to be downloaded, the API will return a<br>response that will include a `download_url`, a `status_url`, as well as<br>any conflicts that might have occurred when creating the request.|[ZipDownload](#schemazipdownload)|
|400|Bad Request|Returns an error if some of the parameters are missing or<br>not valid.<br><br>In most cases, this error might happen because the JSON request body is<br>not valid JSON, any of the items has an incorrect or missing ID, any of<br>the items is not a file or folder, or the root folder with ID `0` has been<br>added to the list of folders to add to the archive.<br><br>The following is a list of common error codes for this response.<br><br>* `bad_request` - the request body is missing, invalid, or both the list<br>of files and folders are empty. Additionally, it this error might be<br>returned when attempting to add the root folder with ID `0` to an archive.<br>* `zip_download_file_count_exceeded_limit` - the requested files and<br>folders would result in an archive with more than 10,000 files. The<br>request will have to be split into multiple requests to reduce the number<br>of files per archive.<br>* `zip_download_pre_compressed_bytes_exceeded_limit` - the requested files<br>and folders would result in an archive with more than the allowed download<br>limit. The request will have to be split into multiple requests to reduce<br>the size of the archive.|[ClientError](#schemaclienterror)|
|401|Unauthorized|Returned when the access token provided in the `Authorization` header<br>is not recognized or not provided.|[ClientError](#schemaclienterror)|
|403|Forbidden|Returned when an authorization header is provided but the user does not<br>have access to the items.|[ClientError](#schemaclienterror)|
|default|Default|An unexpected client error.|[ClientError](#schemaclienterror)|

<aside class="warning">
To perform this operation, you must be authenticated by means of one of the following methods:
OAuth2Security
</aside>

## Download zip archive

<a id="opIdget_zip_downloads_id_content"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/zip_downloads/Lu6fA9Ob-jyysp3AAvMF4AkLEwZwAYbL%3Dtgj2zIC%3DeK9RvJnJbjJl9rNh2qBgHDpyOCAOhpM%3Dvajg2mKq8Mdd/content \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /zip_downloads/{zip_download_id}/content`

Returns the contents of a `zip` archive in binary format. This URL does not
require any form of authentication and could be used in a user's browser to
download the archive to a user's device.

By default, this URL is only valid for a few seconds from the creation of
the request for this archive. Once a download has started it can not be
stopped and resumed, instead a new request for a zip archive would need to
be created.

The URL of this endpoint should not be considered as fixed. Instead, use
the [Create zip download](e://post_zip_downloads) API to request to create a
`zip` archive, and then follow the `download_url` field in the response to
this endpoint.

<h3 id="download-zip-archive-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|zip_download_id|path|string|true|The unique identifier that represent this `zip` archive.|

> Example responses

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "code": "item_name_invalid",
  "context_info": {
    "message": "Something went wrong."
  },
  "help_url": "https://developer.box.com/guides/api-calls/permissions-and-errors/common-errors/",
  "message": "Method Not Allowed",
  "request_id": "abcdef123456",
  "status": 400,
  "type": "error"
}
```

> 429 Response

```json
{
  "code": "item_name_invalid",
  "context_info": {
    "message": "Something went wrong."
  },
  "help_url": "https://developer.box.com/guides/api-calls/permissions-and-errors/common-errors/",
  "message": "Method Not Allowed",
  "request_id": "abcdef123456",
  "status": 400,
```

<h3 id="download-zip-archive-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Returns the content of the items requested for this download, formatted as<br>a stream of files and folders in a `zip` archive.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|Returns an error if the ID of this download request is not valid. This<br>error can also be returned if this URL has been called before. To<br>re-download this archive, please create a new request for a zip download.|[ClientError](#schemaclienterror)|
|429|Too Many Requests|Returns an error if the number of concurrent zip downloads has been<br>reached for either the user or the enterprise.<br><br>* `user_too_many_concurrent_downloads` - the maximum of 5 parallel<br>downloads of zip archives per user has been met.<br>* `enterprise_too_many_concurrent_downloads` - the maximum of 10 parallel<br>downloads of zip archives per enterprise has been met.|[ClientError](#schemaclienterror)|
|default|Default|An unexpected client error.|[ClientError](#schemaclienterror)|

## Get zip download status

<a id="opIdget_zip_downloads_id_status"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/zip_downloads/Lu6fA9Ob-jyysp3AAvMF4AkLEwZwAYbL%3Dtgj2zIC%3DeK9RvJnJbjJl9rNh2qBgHDpyOCAOhpM%3Dvajg2mKq8Mdd/status \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`GET /zip_downloads/{zip_download_id}/status`

Returns the download status of a `zip` archive, allowing an application to
inspect the progress of the download as well as the number of items that
might have been skipped.

This endpoint can only be accessed once the download has started.
Subsequently this endpoint is valid for 12 hours from the start of the
download.

The URL of this endpoint should not be considered as fixed. Instead, use
the [Create zip download](e://post_zip_downloads) API to request to create a
`zip` archive, and then follow the `status_url` field in the response to
this endpoint.

<h3 id="get-zip-download-status-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|zip_download_id|path|string|true|The unique identifier that represent this `zip` archive.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "downloaded_file_count": 10,
  "skipped_file_count": 5,
  "skipped_folder_count": 5,
  "state": "success",
  "total_file_count": 20
}
```

## Unassign storage policy

<a id="opIddelete_storage_policy_assignments_id"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl https://example.com/storage_policy_assignments/932483 \
  -X DELETE \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ACCESS_TOKEN}"
```

`DELETE /storage_policy_assignments/{storage_policy_assignment_id}`

Delete a storage policy assignment.

Deleting a storage policy assignment on a user
will have the user inherit the enterprise's default
storage policy.

There is a rate limit for calling this endpoint of only
twice per user in a 24 hour time frame.

<h3 id="unassign-storage-policy-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|storage_policy_assignment_id|path|string|true|The ID of the storage policy assignment.|

# Schemas

<h2 id="tocS_AccessToken">AccessToken</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaaccesstoken"></a>
<a id="schema_AccessToken"></a>
<a id="tocSaccesstoken"></a>
<a id="tocsaccesstoken"></a>

```json
{
  "access_token": "c3FIOG9vSGV4VHo4QzAyg5T1JvNnJoZ3ExaVNyQWw6WjRsanRKZG5lQk9qUE1BVQ",
  "expires_in": 3600,
  "issued_token_type": "urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token",
  "refresh_token": "c3FIOG9vSGV4VHo4QzAyg5T1JvNnJoZ3ExaVNyQWw6WjRsanRKZG5lQk9qUE1BVQ",
  "restricted_to": [
    {
      "object": {
        "etag": "1",
        "id": "12345",
        "type": "file",
        "file_version": {
          "id": "12345",
          "type": "file_version",
          "sha1": "134b65991ed521fcfe4724b7d814ab8ded5185dc"
        },
        "name": "Contract.pdf",
        "sequence_id": {},
        "sha1": "85136C79CBF9FE36BB9D05D0639C70C265C18D37"
      },
      "scope": "item_download"
    }
  ],
  "token_type": "bearer"
}
```

A token that can be used to make authenticated API calls.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|access_token|string(token)|false|none|The requested access token.|
|expires_in|integer(int64)|false|none|The time in seconds in seconds by which this token will expire.|
|issued_token_type|string(urn)|false|none|The type of downscoped access token returned. This is only<br>returned if an access token has been downscoped.|
|refresh_token|string(token)|false|none|The refresh token for this access token, which can be used<br>to request a new access token when the current one expires.|
|restricted_to|[[FileScope](#schemafilescope)]|false|none|The permissions that this access token permits,<br>providing a list of resources (files, folders, etc)<br>and the scopes permitted for each of those resources.|
|token_type|string|false|none|The type of access token returned.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|issued_token_type|urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token|
|token_type|bearer|

<h2 id="tocS_Classification">Classification</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaclassification"></a>
<a id="schema_Classification"></a>
<a id="tocSclassification"></a>
<a id="tocsclassification"></a>

```json
{
  "$canEdit": true,
  "$parent": "folder_59449484661,",
  "$scope": "enterprise_27335",
  "$template": "securityClassification-6VMVochwUWo",
  "$type": "securityClassification-6VMVochwUWo-fd31537a-0f95-4d86-9f2b-5974a29978f8",
  "$typeVersion": 5,
  "$version": 1,
  "Box__Security__Classification__Key": "Sensitive"
}
```

An instance of the classification metadata template, containing
the classification applied to the file or folder.

To get more details about the classification applied to an item,
request the classification metadata template.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|$canEdit|boolean|false|none|Whether an end user can change the classification.|
|$parent|string|false|none|The identifier of the item that this metadata instance<br>has been attached to. This combines the `type` and the `id`<br>of the parent in the form `{type}_{id}`.|
|$scope|string|false|none|The scope of the enterprise that this classification has been<br>applied for.<br><br>This will be in the format `enterprise_{enterprise_id}`.|
|$template|string|false|none|`securityClassification-6VMVochwUWo`|
|$type|string|false|none|The unique ID of this classification instance. This will be include<br>the name of the classification template and a unique ID.|
|$typeVersion|number|false|none|The version of the metadata template. This version starts at 0 and<br>increases every time the template is updated. This is mostly for internal<br>use.|
|$version|integer|false|none|The version of the metadata instance. This version starts at 0 and<br>increases every time a classification is updated.|
|Box__Security__Classification__Key|string|false|none|The name of the classification applied to the item.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|$template|securityClassification-6VMVochwUWo|

```json
  "copyInstanceOnItemCopy": true,

    {
      "displayName": "Classification",
      "hidden": false,
      "id": "822227e0-47a5-921b-88a8-494760b2e6d2",
```

folders, similar to access control lists. A collaboration object grants a
user or group access to a file or folder with permissions defined by a
specific role.

|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When the collaboration object was created|
|created_by|object|false|none|none|
|expires_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When the collaboration will expire, or `null` if no expiration<br>date is set.|
|id|string|false|none|The unique identifier for this collaboration.|
|invite_email|string \| null|false|none|The email address used to invite an unregistered collaborator, if<br>they are not a registered user.|

|modified_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When the collaboration object was last modified|
|role|string|false|none|The level of access granted.|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the collaboration invitation.|
|type|string|false|none|`collaboration`|

A retention policy blocks permanent deletion of content
for a specified amount of time. Admins can apply policies to
specified folders, or an entire enterprise. A file version retention
is a  record for a retained file version. To use this feature,
you must  have the manage retention policies scope enabled for your
API key via  your application management console. For more information
about retention policies, please visit our help documentation

|type|string|true|none|`folder`|
|name|string|false|none|The name of the folder.|
|sequence_id|object|false|none|none|
|content_created_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The date and time at which this folder was originally<br>created.|
|content_modified_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The date and time at which this folder was last updated.|

|modified_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The date and time when the folder was last updated. This value may<br>be `null` for some folders such as the root folder or the trash<br>folder.|
|modified_by|object|true|none|none|
|owned_by|object|true|none|none|

|path_collection|object|true|none|none|

|size|integer(int64)|true|none|The folder size in bytes.<br><br>Be careful parsing this integer as its<br>value can get very large.|

Example values of this field<br>could be an Active Directory Object ID or a Google<br>Group ID.  We recommend you use of this field in<br>order to avoid issues when group names are updated in<br>either Box or external systems.|
|invitability_level|string|false|none|Specifies who can invite the group to collaborate<br>on items.<br><br>When set to `admins_only` the enterprise admin, co-admins,<br>and the group's admin can invite the group.<br><br>When set to `admins_and_members` all the admins listed<br>above and group members can invite the group.<br><br>When set to `all_managed_users` all managed users in the<br>enterprise can invite the group.|
|member_viewability_level|string|false|none|Specifies who can view the members of the group<br>(Get Memberships for Group).<br><br>* `admins_only` - the enterprise admin, co-admins, group's<br>  group admin<br>* `admins_and_members` - all admins and group members<br>* `all_managed_users` - all managed users in the<br>  enterprise|
|permissions|object|false|none|none|
|provenance|string|false|none|Keeps track of which external source this group is<br>coming from (e.g. "Active Directory", "Google Groups",<br>"Facebook Groups").  Setting this will<br>also prevent Box users from editing the group name<br>and its members directly via the Box web application.<br>This is desirable for one-way syncing of groups.|

Legal Hold Assignments are used to assign Legal Hold
Policies to Users, Folders, Files, or File Versions.

Creating a Legal Hold Assignment puts a hold
on the File-Versions that belong to the Assignment's
'apply-to' entity.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|false|none|The unique identifier for this legal hold assignment|
|type|string|false|none|`legal_hold_policy_assignment`|
|assigned_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When the legal hold policy assignment object was<br>created|
|assigned_by|object|false|none|none|
|assigned_to|object|false|none|none|
|deleted_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When the assignment release request was sent.<br>(Because it can take time for an assignment to fully<br>delete, this isn't quite the same time that the<br>assignment is fully deleted). If null, Assignment<br>was not deleted.|
|legal_hold_policy|object|false|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|legal_hold_policy_assignment|

A metadata cascade policy automatically applies a metadata template instance
to all the files and folders within the targeted folder.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|false|none|The ID of the metadata cascade policy object|
|owner_enterprise|object|false|none|The enterprise that owns this policy.|
|parent|object|false|none|Represent the folder the policy is applied to.|
|scope|string|false|none|The scope of the of the template that is cascaded down to the folder's<br>children.|
|templateKey|string|false|none|The key of the template that is cascaded down to the folder's<br>children.<br><br>In many cases the template key is automatically derived<br>of its display name, for example `Contract Template` would<br>become `contractTemplate`. In some cases the creator of the<br>template will have provided its own template key.<br><br>Please [list the templates for an enterprise][list], or<br>get all instances on a [file][file] or [folder][folder]<br>to inspect a template's key.<br><br>[list]: e://get-metadata-templates-enterprise<br>[file]: e://get-files-id-metadata<br>[folder]: e://get-folders-id-metadata|
|type|string|false|none|`metadata_cascade_policy`|

<h2 id="tocS_MetadataQuery">MetadataQuery</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemametadataquery"></a>
<a id="schema_MetadataQuery"></a>
<a id="tocSmetadataquery"></a>
<a id="tocsmetadataquery"></a>

```json
{
  "ancestor_folder_id": "0",
  "fields": [
    "extension",
    "created_at",
    "item_status",
    "metadata.enterprise_1234.contracts",
    "metadata.enterprise_1234.regions.location"
  ],
  "from": "enterprise_123456.someTemplate",
  "limit": 50,
  "marker": "AAAAAmVYB1FWec8GH6yWu2nwmanfMh07IyYInaa7DZDYjgO1H4KoLW29vPlLY173OKsci6h6xGh61gG73gnaxoS+o0BbI1/h6le6cikjlupVhASwJ2Cj0tOD9wlnrUMHHw3/ISf+uuACzrOMhN6d5fYrbidPzS6MdhJOejuYlvsg4tcBYzjauP3+VU51p77HFAIuObnJT0ff",
  "order_by": [
    {
      "direction": "asc",
      "field_key": "amount"
    }
  ],
  "query": "value >= :amount",
  "query_params": {
    "amount": "100"
  }
}
```

Create a search using SQL-like syntax to return items that match specific
metadata.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|ancestor_folder_id|string|true|none|The ID of the folder that you are restricting the query to. A<br>value of zero will return results from all folders you have access<br>to. A non-zero value will only return results found in the folder<br>corresponding to the ID or in any of its subfolders.|
|fields|[string]|false|none|By default, this endpoint returns only the most basic info about the items for<br>which the query matches. This attribute can be used to specify a list of<br>additional attributes to return for any item, including its metadata.<br><br>This attribute takes a list of item fields, metadata template identifiers,<br>or metadata template field identifiers.<br><br>For example:<br><br>* `created_by` will add the details of the user who created the item to<br>the response.<br>* `metadata.<scope>.<templateKey>` will return the mini-representation<br>of the metadata instance identified by the `scope` and `templateKey`.<br>* `metadata.<scope>.<templateKey>.<field>` will return all the mini-representation<br>of the metadata instance identified by the `scope` and `templateKey` plus<br>the field specified by the `field` name. Multiple fields for the same<br>`scope` and `templateKey` can be defined.|
|from|string|true|none|Specifies the template used in the query. Must be in the form<br>`scope.templateKey`. Not all templates can be used in this field,<br>most notably the built-in, Box-provided classification templates<br>can not be used in a query.|
|limit|integer|false|none|A value between 0 and 100 that indicates the maximum number of results<br>to return for a single request. This only specifies a maximum<br>boundary and will not guarantee the minimum number of results<br>returned.|
|marker|string|false|none|Marker to use for requesting the next page.|
|order_by|[object]|false|none|A list of template fields and directions to sort the metadata query<br>results by.<br><br>The ordering `direction` must be the same for each item in the array.|
|query|string|false|none|The query to perform. A query is a logical expression that is very similar<br>to a SQL `SELECT` statement. Values in the search query can be turned into<br>parameters specified in the `query_param` arguments list to prevent having<br>to manually insert search values into the query string.<br><br>For example, a value of `:amount` would represent the `amount` value in<br>`query_params` object.|
|query_params|object|false|none|Set of arguments corresponding to the parameters specified in the<br>`query`. The type of each parameter used in the `query_params` must match<br>the type of the corresponding metadata template field.|

<a id="tocsmetadatatemplate"></a>

```json
{
  "copyInstanceOnItemCopy": true,
  "displayName": "Product Info",
  "fields": [
    {
      "description": "The category",
      "displayName": "Category",
      "hidden": true,
      "key": "category",
      "options": [
        {
          "key": "Category 1",
          "id": "45dc2849-a4a7-40a9-a751-4a699a589190"
        }
      ],
      "type": "string",
      "id": "822227e0-47a5-921b-88a8-494760b2e6d2"
    }
  ],
  "hidden": true,
  "id": "58063d82-4128-7b43-bba9-92f706befcdf",
  "scope": "enterprise_123456",
  "templateKey": "productInfo",
  "type": "metadata_template"
}
```

A template for metadata that can be applied to files and folders

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|copyInstanceOnItemCopy|boolean|false|none|Whether or not to include the metadata when a file or folder is copied.|
|displayName|string|false|none|The display name of the template. This can be seen in the Box web app<br>and mobile apps.|
|fields|[object]|false|none|An ordered list of template fields which are part of the template. Each<br>field can be a regular text field, date field, number field, as well as a<br>single or multi-select list.|
|hidden|boolean|false|none|Defines if this template is visible in the Box web app UI, or if<br>it is purely intended for usage through the API.|
|id|string|false|none|The ID of the metadata template.|
|scope|string|false|none|The scope of the metadata template can either be `global` or<br>`enterprise_*`. The `global` scope is used for templates that are<br>available to any Box enterprise. The `enterprise_*` scope represents<br>templates that have been created within a specific enterprise, where `*`<br>will be the ID of that enterprise.|
|templateKey|string|false|none|A unique identifier for the template. This identifier is unique across<br>the `scope` of the enterprise to which the metadata template is being<br>applied, yet is not necessarily unique across different enterprises.|
|type|string|true|none|`metadata_template`|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|metadata_template|

```json
  "actor_token_type": "urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:id_token",
  "assertion": "xxxxx.yyyyy.zzzzz",

```

A request for a new OAuth 2.0 token

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|actor_token|string(token)|false|none|The token used to create an annotator token.<br>This is a JWT assertion.<br><br>Used in combination with `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange`<br>as the `grant_type`.|
|actor_token_type|string(urn)|false|none|The type of `actor_token` passed in.<br><br>Used in combination with `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange`<br>as the `grant_type`.|
|assertion|string(jwt)|false|none|A JWT assertion for which to request a new access token.<br><br>Used in combination with `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer`<br>as the `grant_type`.|
|box_shared_link|string(url)|false|none|Full URL of the shared link on the file or folder<br>that the token should be generated for.|
|box_subject_id|string|false|none|Used in combination with `client_credentials` as the `grant_type`.<br>Value is determined by `box_subject_type`. If `user` use user ID and if<br>`enterprise` use enterprise ID.|
|box_subject_type|string|false|none|Used in combination with `client_credentials` as the `grant_type`.|
|client_id|string|false|none|The Client ID of the application requesting an access token.<br><br>Used in combination with `authorization_code`, `client_credentials`, or<br>`urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer` as the `grant_type`.|
|client_secret|string|false|none|The client secret of the application requesting an access token.<br><br>Used in combination with `authorization_code`, `client_credentials`, or<br>`urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer` as the `grant_type`.|
|code|string(token)|false|none|The client-side authorization code passed to your application by<br>Box in the browser redirect after the user has successfully<br>granted your application permission to make API calls on their<br>behalf.<br><br>Used in combination with `authorization_code` as the `grant_type`.|
|grant_type|string(urn)|true|none|The type of request being made, either using a client-side obtained<br>authorization code, a refresh token, a JWT assertion, client credentials<br>grant or another access token for the purpose of downscoping a token.|
|refresh_token|string(token)|false|none|A refresh token used to get a new access token with.<br><br>Used in combination with `refresh_token` as the `grant_type`.|
|resource|string(url)|false|none|Full URL for the file that the token should be generated for.|
|scope|string(space_delimited_list)|false|none|The space-delimited list of scopes that you want apply to the<br>new access token.<br><br>The `subject_token` will need to have all of these scopes or<br>the call will error with **401 Unauthorized**.|
|subject_token|string(token)|false|none|The token to exchange for a downscoped token. This can be a regular<br>access token, a JWT assertion, or an app token.<br><br>Used in combination with `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange`<br>as the `grant_type`.|
|subject_token_type|string|false|none|The type of `subject_token` passed in.<br><br>Used in combination with `urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange`<br>as the `grant_type`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|actor_token_type|urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:id_token|
|box_subject_type|enterprise|
|box_subject_type|user|
|grant_type|authorization_code|
|grant_type|refresh_token|
|grant_type|client_credentials|
|grant_type|urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer|
|grant_type|urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange|
|subject_token_type|urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token|

A real-time server that can be used for
long polling user events

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|max_retries|integer|false|none|The maximum number of retries this server will<br>allow before a new long poll should be started by<br>getting a [new list of server](#options-events).|
|retry_timeout|integer|false|none|The maximum number of seconds without a response<br>after which you should retry the long poll connection.<br><br>This helps to overcome network issues where the long<br>poll looks to be working but no packages are coming<br>through.|
|ttl|integer|false|none|The time in minutes for which this server is available|
|type|string|false|none|`realtime_server`|
|url|string|false|none|The URL for the server.|

<h2 id="tocS_RetentionPolicy">RetentionPolicy</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaretentionpolicy"></a>
<a id="schema_RetentionPolicy"></a>
<a id="tocSretentionpolicy"></a>
<a id="tocsretentionpolicy"></a>

```json
{
  "id": "12345",
  "type": "retention_policy",
  "disposition_action": "permanently_delete",
  "policy_name": "Some Policy Name",
  "retention_length": "365",
  "are_owners_notified": false,
  "assignment_counts": {
    "enterprise": 1,
    "folder": 1,
    "metadata_template": 1
  },
  "can_owner_extend_retention": false,
  "created_at": "2012-12-12T10:53:43-08:00",
  "created_by": {
    "id": "11446498",
    "type": "user",
    "login": "ceo@example.com",
    "name": "Aaron Levie"
  },
  "custom_notification_recipients": [
    {
      "id": "11446498",
      "type": "user",
      "login": "ceo@example.com",
      "name": "Aaron Levie"
    }
  ],
  "description": "Policy to retain all reports for at least one month",
  "modified_at": "2012-12-12T10:53:43-08:00",
  "policy_type": "finite",
  "retention_type": "non-modifiable",
  "status": "active"
}
```

A retention policy blocks permanent deletion of content
for a specified amount of time. Admins can create retention
policies and then later assign them to specific folders, metadata
templates, or their entire enterprise.  To use this feature, you must
have the manage retention policies scope enabled
for your API key via your application management console.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|id|string|true|none|The unique identifier that represents a retention policy.|
|type|string|true|none|`retention_policy`|
|disposition_action|string|false|none|The disposition action of the retention policy.<br>This action can be `permanently_delete`, which<br>will cause the content retained by the policy<br>to be permanently deleted, or `remove_retention`,<br>which will lift the retention policy from the content,<br>allowing it to be deleted by users,<br>once the retention policy has expired.|
|policy_name|string|false|none|The name given to the retention policy.|
|retention_length|string(int32)|false|none|The length of the retention policy. This value<br>specifies the duration in days that the retention<br>policy will be active for after being assigned to<br>content.  If the policy has a `policy_type` of<br>`indefinite`, the `retention_length` will also be<br>`indefinite`.|
|are_owners_notified|boolean|false|none|Determines if owners and co-owners of items<br>under the policy are notified when<br>the retention duration is about to end.|
|assignment_counts|object|false|none|Counts the retention policy assignments for each item type.|
|can_owner_extend_retention|boolean|false|none|Determines if the owner of items under the policy<br>can extend the retention when the original<br>retention duration is about to end.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When the retention policy object was created.|
|created_by|object|false|none|none|
|custom_notification_recipients|[[User--Mini](#schemauser--mini)]|false|none|A list of users notified when the retention policy duration is about to end.|
|description|string|false|none|The additional text description of the retention policy.|
|modified_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When the retention policy object was last modified.|
|policy_type|string|false|none|The type of the retention policy. A retention<br>policy type can either be `finite`, where a<br>specific amount of time to retain the content is known<br>upfront, or `indefinite`, where the amount of time<br>to retain the content is still unknown.|
|retention_type|string|false|none|Specifies the retention type:<br><br>* `modifiable`: You can modify the retention policy. For example,<br> you can add or remove folders, shorten or lengthen<br> the policy duration, or delete the assignment.<br> Use this type if your retention policy<br> is not related to any regulatory purposes.<br><br>* `non-modifiable`: You can modify the retention policy<br> only in a limited way: add a folder, lengthen the duration,<br> retire the policy, change the disposition action<br> or notification settings. You cannot perform other actions,<br> such as deleting the assignment or shortening the<br> policy duration. Use this type to ensure<br> compliance with regulatory retention policies.|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the retention policy. The status of<br>a policy will be `active`, unless explicitly retired by an<br>administrator, in which case the status will be `retired`.<br>Once a policy has been retired, it cannot become<br>active again.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|type|retention_policy|
|disposition_action|permanently_delete|
|disposition_action|remove_retention|
|policy_type|finite|
|policy_type|indefinite|
|retention_type|modifiable|
|retention_type|non-modifiable|
|status|active|
|status|retired|

or hold all files in the enterprise.

A Sign Request Object

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|are_reminders_enabled|boolean|false|none|Reminds signers to sign a document on day 3, 8, 13 and 18. Reminders are only sent to outstanding signers.|
|are_text_signatures_enabled|boolean|false|none|Disables the usage of signatures generated by typing (text).|
|days_valid|integer \| null|false|none|Number of days after which this request will automatically expire if not completed.|
|declined_redirect_url|string \| null|false|none|The uri that a signer will be redirected to after declining to sign a document.|
|email_message|string \| null|false|none|Message to include in sign request email. The field is cleaned through sanitization of specific characters. However, some html tags are allowed. Links included in the message are also converted to hyperlinks in the email. The message may contain the following html tags including `a`, `abbr`, `acronym`, `b`, `blockquote`, `code`, `em`, `i`, `ul`, `li`, `ol`, and `strong`. Be aware that when the text to html ratio is too high, the email may end up in spam filters. Custom styles on these tags are not allowed. If this field is not passed, a default message will be used.|
|email_subject|string \| null|false|none|Subject of sign request email. This is cleaned by sign request. If this field is not passed, a default subject will be used.|
|external_id|string \| null|false|none|This can be used to reference an ID in an external system that the sign request is related to.|
|is_document_preparation_needed|boolean|false|none|Indicates if the sender should receive a `prepare_url` in the response to complete document preparation via UI.|
|is_phone_verification_required_to_view|boolean \| null|false|none|Forces signers to verify a text message prior to viewing the document. You must specify the phone number of signers to have this setting apply to them.|
|name|string|false|none|Name of the sign request.|
|parent_folder|object|true|none|none|
|prefill_tags|[[SignRequestPrefillTag](#schemasignrequestprefilltag)]|false|none|When a document contains sign related tags in the content, you can prefill them using this `prefill_tags` by referencing the 'id' of the tag as the `external_id` field of the prefill tag.|
|redirect_url|string \| null|false|none|When specified, signature request will be redirected to this url when a document is signed.|
|auto_expire_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|Uses `days_valid` to calculate the date and time, in GMT, the sign request will expire if unsigned.|
|id|string|false|none|Sign request ID|
|prepare_url|string \| null|false|none|This URL is returned if `is_document_preparation_needed` is<br>set to `true` in the request. It is used to prepare the sign request<br>via UI. The sign request is not sent until preparation is complete.|
|sign_files|object|false|none|List of files that will be signed, which are copies of the original<br>source files. A new version of these files are created as signers sign<br>and can be downloaded at any point in the signing process.|
|signature_color|string \| null|false|none|Force a specific color for the signature (blue, black, or red).|
|signers|[[SignRequestSigner](#schemasignrequestsigner)]|false|none|Array of signers for the sign request|
|signing_log|object|false|none|none|
|source_files|[[File--Mini](#schemafile--mini)]|true|none|List of files to create a signing document from. Only the ID and type fields are required for each file. The array will be empty if the `source_files` are deleted.|
|status|string|false|none|Describes the status of the sign request|
|type|string|false|none|object type|

|Property|Value|
|---|---|

|status|created|
|status|sent|
|status|viewed|
|status|signed|
|status|cancelled|
|status|declined|
|status|error_converting|
|status|error_sending|
|status|expired|
|type|sign-request|

The schema for a Signer in a POST Sign Request request body

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|declined_redirect_url|string \| null|false|none|The URL that a signer will be redirect<br>to after declining to sign a document.<br>Defining this URL overrides default or global<br>declined redirect URL settings for a specific signer.|
|email|string|true|none|Email address of the signer|
|embed_url_external_user_id|string|false|none|User ID for the signer in an external application responsible<br>for authentication when accessing the embed URL.|
|is_in_person|boolean|false|none|Used in combination with an embed URL for a sender. After the<br>sender signs, they are redirected to the next `in_person` signer.|
|login_required|boolean \| null|false|none|If set to true, signer will need to login to a Box account<br>before signing the request. If the signer does not have<br>an existing account, they will have an option to create<br>a free Box account.|
|order|integer|false|none|Order of the signer|
|password|string|false|write-only|If set, the signer is required to enter the password before they are able<br>to sign a document. This field is write only.|
|redirect_url|string \| null|false|none|The URL that a signer will be redirected<br>to after signing a document. Defining this URL<br>overrides default or global redirect URL<br>settings for a specific signer.<br>If no declined redirect URL is specified,<br>this URL will be used for decline actions as well.|
|role|string|false|none|Defines the role of the signer in the sign request. A `signer`<br>must sign the document and an `approver` must approve the document. A<br>`final_copy_reader` only receives the final signed document and signing<br>log.|
|verification_phone_number|string|false|none|If set, this phone number is be used to verify the signer<br>via two factor authentication before they are able to sign the document.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|role|signer|
|role|approver|
|role|final_copy_reader|

A task allows for file-centric workflows within Box. Users can
create tasks on files and assign them to other users for them to complete the
tasks.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|action|string|false|none|The type of task the task assignee will be prompted to<br>perform.|
|completion_rule|string|false|none|Defines which assignees need to complete this task before the task<br>is considered completed.<br><br>* `all_assignees` requires all assignees to review or<br>approve the the task in order for it to be considered completed.<br>* `any_assignee` accepts any one assignee to review or<br>approve the the task in order for it to be considered completed.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When the task object was created|
|created_by|object|false|none|none|
|due_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When the task is due|
|id|string|false|none|The unique identifier for this task|
|is_completed|boolean|false|none|Whether the task has been completed|
|item|object|false|none|none|
|message|string|false|none|A message that will be included with the task|
|task_assignment_collection|object|false|none|none|
|type|string|false|none|`task`|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|action|review|
|action|complete|
|completion_rule|all_assignees|
|completion_rule|any_assignee|
|type|task|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|content_created_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The date and time at which this file was originally<br>created, which might be before it was uploaded to Box.|
|content_modified_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The date and time at which this file was last updated,<br>which might be before it was uploaded to Box.|
|created_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when the file was created on Box.|
|created_by|object|false|none|none|
|description|string|true|none|The optional description of this file|
|etag|string \| null|false|none|The HTTP `etag` of this file. This can be used within some API<br>endpoints in the `If-Match` and `If-None-Match` headers to only<br>perform changes on the file if (no) changes have happened.|
|file_version|object|false|none|none|
|id|string|true|none|The unique identifier that represent a file.<br><br>The ID for any file can be determined<br>by visiting a file in the web application<br>and copying the ID from the URL. For example,<br>for the URL `https://*.app.box.com/files/123`<br>the `file_id` is `123`.|
|item_status|string|true|none|Defines if this item has been deleted or not.<br><br>* `active` when the item has is not in the trash<br>* `trashed` when the item has been moved to the trash but not deleted<br>* `deleted` when the item has been permanently deleted.|
|modified_at|string(date-time)|true|none|The date and time when the file was last updated on Box.|
|modified_by|object|true|none|none|
|name|string|false|none|The name of the file|
|owned_by|object|true|none|none|
|parent|object|false|none|none|
|path_collection|object|true|none|none|
|purged_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The time at which this file is expected to be purged<br>from the trash.|
|sequence_id|object|true|none|none|
|sha1|string(digest)|true|none|The SHA1 hash of the file. This can be used to compare the contents<br>of a file on Box with a local file.|
|shared_link|string \| null|false|none|The shared link for this file. This will<br>be `null` if a file has been trashed, since the link will no longer<br>be active.|
|size|integer|true|none|The file size in bytes. Be careful parsing this integer as it can<br>get very large and cause an integer overflow.|
|trashed_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|The time at which this file was put in the trash.|
|type|string|true|none|`file`|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|item_status|active|
|item_status|trashed|
|item_status|deleted|
|type|file|

are also known as bookmarks within the Box web application.

Web link objects are treated similarly to file objects,
they will also support most actions that apply to regular files.

|sequence_id|object|false|none|none|

|created_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When this file was created on Box’s servers.|
|created_by|object|false|none|none|
|description|string|false|none|The description accompanying the web link. This is<br>visible within the Box web application.|
|item_status|string|false|none|Whether this item is deleted or not. Values include `active`,<br>`trashed` if the file has been moved to the trash, and `deleted` if<br>the file has been permanently deleted|
|modified_at|string(date-time)|false|none|When this file was last updated on the Box<br>servers.|
|modified_by|object|false|none|none|
|owned_by|object|false|none|none|
|parent|object|false|none|none|
|path_collection|object|false|none|none|

|shared_link|object|false|none|none|
|trashed_at|string(date-time) \| null|false|none|When this file was moved to the trash.|

```json
{
  "download_url": "https://dl.boxcloud.com/2.0/zip_downloads/29l00nfxDyHOt7RphI9zT_w==nDnZEDjY2S8iEWWCHEEiptFxwoWojjlibZjJ6geuE5xnXENDTPxzgbks_yY=/content",
  "expires_at": "2020-07-22T11:26:08Z",
  "name_conflicts": [
    [
      {
        "download_name": "3aa6a7.pdf",
        "id": "12345",
        "original_name": "Report.pdf",
        "type": "file"
      },
      {
        "download_name": "5d53f2.pdf",
        "id": "34325",
        "original_name": "Report.pdf",
        "type": "file"
      }
    ]
  ],
  "status_url": "https://api.box.com/2.0/zip_downloads/29l00nfxDyHOt7RphI9zT_w==nDnZEDjY2S8iEWWCHEEiptFxwoWojjlibZjJ6geuE5xnXENDTPxzgbks_yY=/status"
}
```

Represents a successful request to create a `zip` archive of a list of files
and folders.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|download_url|string|false|none|The URL that can be used to download the `zip` archive. A `Get` request to<br>this URL will start streaming the items requested. By default, this URL<br>is only valid for a few seconds, until the `expires_at` time, unless a<br>download is started after which it is valid for the duration of the<br>download.<br><br>It is important to note that the domain and path of this URL might change<br>between API calls, and therefore it's important to use this URL as-is.|
|expires_at|string(date-time)|false|none|The time and date when this archive will expire. After this time the<br>`status_url` and `download_url` will return an error.<br><br>By default, these URLs are only valid for a few seconds, unless a download<br>is started after which the `download_url` is valid for the duration of the<br>download, and the `status_url` is valid for 12 hours from the start of the<br>download.|
|name_conflicts|[[object]]|false|none|A list of conflicts that occurred when trying to create the archive. This<br>would occur when multiple items have been requested with the<br>same name.<br><br>To solve these conflicts, the API will automatically rename an item<br>and return a mapping between the original item's name and its new<br>name.<br><br>For every conflict, both files will be renamed and therefore this list<br>will always be a multiple of 2.|
|status_url|string|false|none|The URL that can be used to get the status of the `zip` archive being<br>downloaded. A `Get` request to this URL will return the number of files<br>in the archive as well as the number of items already downloaded or<br>skipped. By default, this URL is only valid for a few seconds, until the<br>`expires_at` time, unless a download is started after which the URL is<br>valid for 12 hours from the start of the download.<br><br>It is important to note that the domain and path of this URL might change<br>between API calls, and therefore it's important to use this URL as-is.|

<h2 id="tocS_ZipDownloadStatus">ZipDownloadStatus</h2>

<a id="schemazipdownloadstatus"></a>

```json
{
  "downloaded_file_count": 10,
  "skipped_file_count": 5,
  "skipped_folder_count": 5,
  "state": "success",
  "total_file_count": 20
}
```

The status of a `zip` archive being downloaded.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|downloaded_file_count|integer|false|none|The number of files that have already been downloaded.|
|skipped_file_count|integer|false|none|The number of files that have been skipped as they could not be<br>downloaded. In many cases this is due to permission issues that have<br>surfaced between the creation of the request for the archive and the<br>archive being downloaded.|
|skipped_folder_count|integer|false|none|The number of folders that have been skipped as they could not be<br>downloaded. In many cases this is due to permission issues that have<br>surfaced between the creation of the request for the archive and the<br>archive being downloaded.|
|state|string|false|none|The state of the archive being downloaded.|
|total_file_count|integer|false|none|The total number of files in the archive.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|state|in_progress|
|state|failed|
|state|success|
